newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope sends condolences after Iran quake.
newsitem.headline: Pope sends condolences after Iran quake.

text.p: Pope John Paul sent his condolences to Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Monday after a devastating earthquake killed nearly 2,400 people in eastern Iran.

"Profoundly saddened by news of the loss of life and devastation due to the recent earthquakes in your nation, I wish to assure your excellency of my heartfelt concern and solidarity," the Pope said in a telegram to Rafsanjani.
"With fervent prayers I commend the victims to the gracious mercy of almighty God," he said.
Another earthquake hit Iran on Monday but was less severe than Saturday's quake, which measured 7.1 on the Richter scale.
